choiceIssues: The description of choice イ is wrong. In the source, イ has a hooked L-shaped slot lying horizontally on the left, a horizontal flat slot on the right, and a round ground hole at the bottom center. The JSON describes it as 'two horizontal flat slots side by side on top' and also 'two vertically elongated slots side by side', which contradicts itself and misses the L-shaped slot.

In choice ニ, left and right are reversed. In the source, ニ has the L-shaped (hooked) slot on the left and a vertical flat slot on the right, with the ground hole at the bottom. The JSON says '左側に縦向き、右側にL字状'.
The descriptions of ロ (two vertical flat slots + ground hole) and ハ (two horizontal flat slots + ground hole) match the source.
